limits: Node command kernels, not Electron click latency. Tiny controls are unchanged and differences can reflect JIT/host noise. No causal timing assigned to individual ledger entries. Both roots must contain the shared round3 fixture factory; baseline checkout is any clean git checkout of the recorded revision, not a permanently required temporary path.
